premises.text: Engineers lose productivity to environment mismatch bugs, long test waits, and team-blocking build breaks
premises.evidence_span: our development environments never matched up with our production environments

premises.text: Quality isolates each push in limbo and tests it against multiple production-like replicas in a chosen cloud
premises.evidence_span: takes that change and holds it in a limbo state

premises.text: The platform chunks the automation suite across replicas in high-way parallel for fast test turnaround
premises.evidence_span: it will chunk up your automation test suite, and it'll just throw it at these replicas in parallel

premises.text: Failed changes never merge, so build breaks do not block the rest of the team
premises.evidence_span: nobody else has actually seen this change. The build is not broken

premises.text: Making existing engineers about 20% more effective substitutes for hard external hiring
premises.evidence_span: quality can make your development team 20% more effective

premises.text: On-prem/firewall-capable product lets companies buy what Google and Facebook had to build internally
premises.evidence_span: deployed on site behind your firewall at your company

domains.name: buyable on-prem alternative to FAANG tooling

value.text: Engineering teams ship faster with happier, more effective developers and unbroken builds
value.evidence_span: unleash your engineers and radically change the way that they actually write software
